scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
You're inside Sir Zhed's
looking for new employees,
I don't think you're suited
for this kind of domestic
work, brave adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I am Vincert, steward of
this mansion and faithful
servant to its master, Sir
Zhed, the most powerful
man in all of Arunafeltz.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
My master is currently out
to attend the High Priest
assembly, and has been gone
for a few days. I would like to
ask you for your help with
a problem on his behalf.
I'm too busy.
Sure, why not?

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I understand.
I'm sorry that you're
too busy at the moment...
If you should be available
later, then I'd like to ask for
your assistance once again.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Thank you. You see,
the pope awarded Sir Zhed
for his great contributions to
Arunafeltz with a precious gem.
However, this jewel is missing
and I need your help to find it.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I don't have any proof, but
I suspect it was stolen by
Phobe, a servant that
disappeared about the same
time the gem disappeared.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Please retrieve this gem
and find who stole it before
Sir Zhed returns and finds
out what happened. If you
can keep this secret, I'd
very much appreciate it.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I believe that you'd want
to interrogate Phobe, but
he has run away somewhere.
You might want to question the
other servants of his whereabouts. Thanks again for your help.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I suggest looking around
the mansion and asking the
servants for any clues about
Phobe's current location.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
We're running out
of time... Please find
the gem and Phobe
as soon as you can.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Ah...!
H-hello! How are
you still, er... That
look on your face? Did
you happen to find Logan?

No! I actually got
stabbed by Mogan, and
then we had a talk. What's
the big idea? I come to help
you, and you try to have me
killed! I want an explanation!

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I... Yes, you deserve
the truth after wh-what
I tried to do to you. First
of all, Phobe is my son, but
please don't tell anybody!

What?
Why, what's
the big deal?

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
There's something of
a class system here in
Arunafeltz. No one talks
about it, but those that
immigrated here and built this
city are the dominant class.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
The native people are
second class citizens that
are looked down upon by the
descendents of the settlers
that developed this city. It
is a sad, undeniable truth.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
The native people typically
suffer from lower class status,
and usually do the hard, blue
collar work in the city. Jenny,
Phobe's mother, is one of them.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
It's taboo for me to love her,
especially since Sir Zhed has
taken me under his wing and
been like a father to me. If
I married her, it'd greatly
damage his reputation.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I tried to control my
feelings but... Well,
Phobe was born. And there's
no going back now. We did
get secretly married though,
and I don't regret that.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Phobe must resent me...
I've had to treat him and
his mother like slaves
in front of other people.
I know it's horrible... To be
so cold to those you love.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
When he ran off with the
jewel, I was actually more
worried about Phobe than
my master's treasure. So...
I did what I could to try to
get him back: I hired you.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
However, once you found
Phobe, I planned to have
you killed so that we could
blame you for the theft. I'm
sorry, I know it's wrong, but
I was so worried about my boy!

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
I hope you forgive me...
I'll do what I should've
done from the beginning...
I'll take full responsibility
for the gem's theft, and Sir
Zhed can do to me what he will.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
The gem is very special...
Our pope commanded my
master to keep the jewel
safely, as it has the power
to save Arunafeltz and Rachel
when the time comes.

The gem is really that
important, huh? Well, you
almost had me killed, but
since I'm still alive, I guess
I can overlook it, you know?

You won't get in trouble
if I can find the jewel and
Phobe before Sir Zhed
returns, so I'll try to find
them for you as soon as I can.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
You're willing to
do that for me? ^333333*Sob*^000000
Even after what I've put
you through? ^333333*Sniff*^000000

Eh, I went through all
this trouble already, so
I might as well finish the
job. Besides, Phobe is
just a kid, so he's probably
hiding somewhere in town.

Huh? Oh yeah, he's

give me the gem he stole.

So... I earned my
reward now, right?
And no one has to die?

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Yes, yes, thank you so

what you've done for me.
Oh, my boy is alright!

H-hey! Um, take
this jewel! You need

it's supposed to go, right?

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Oh, yes, I'd better do
that. While I return this
jewel, would you please
tell my wife Jenny that our
boy is okay? She's been
very worried about him, so...

You want me to tell
Jenny about Phobe?
Sure, sure, I'll do that.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Oh! While I return this
jewel, would you please
tell my wife Jenny that our
boy is okay? She's been
very worried about him, so...

You want me to tell
Jenny about Phobe?
Sure, sure, I'll do that.

I told Jenny that
about Phobe, and that
the gem was returned...
She seemed pretty relieved...

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Thank you so much,
adventurer. She's such
a kind, loving woman, and
I hate to see her go through
all that torment. I don't deserve
such a beautiful woman...

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
It's very fortunate that
you've come to save us...
Please drop by the next
time that you're in Rachel,
and I'll try to help you if I can.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Ah, actually, I have
one last favor to ask
of you. Would you please
bring this note and package
to my master? He should still
be in the temple right now.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
If you ask for High
Priest Zhed and mention
that I sent you, then he
will meet with you.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Now is the time for
me to give you your
reward. How about that?
I don't know what's inside,
but I know these items are
quite valuable nowadays...

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Ah, and this note is a
letter of recommendation
that I have written for you.
Please deliver it to Sir Zhed
as soon as possible. Good bye,
and thank you for everything.

scripts.speaker: Vincent
scripts.text:
Thank you for everything
that you've done for me
and my family. If you ever
need help, please don't
hesitate to ask me, alright?

scripts.speaker: Logan
scripts.text:
I'm just Logan, one
of the many servants
working here in Sir Zhed's
glorious mansion. I've got
a lot of work to do, so don't
don't distract me, please.

Excuse me, but do
you know man named
Phobe by any chance?
I heard that he used
to work around here.

scripts.speaker: Logan
scripts.text:
Er, may I ask
you are? Why are

Well, I've just been
hired to look for him,

the servants around here

scripts.speaker: Logan
scripts.text:
Oh, okay. Yeah, Phobe's
been missing ever since

I hope the kid is alright.

Er, kid? Just
how old is Phobe?

scripts.speaker: Logan
scripts.text:
He just turned fifteen.
That's all I know about
him. Truth be told, I don't

started working here. Why don't
you ask the senior employees?

scripts.speaker: Logan
scripts.text:
Let's see...
You could ask Mr. Manson
inside the mansion. He's
been working here for a while.

scripts.speaker: Logan
scripts.text:
If you want to learn
more about Phobe, you'd
better ask one of the senior
employees since I just started

the mansion is a good bet.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
I am Manson, one of the
many servants working here
in Sir Zhed's mansion. Er,
would you be more careful
walking around here? I hate
cleaning up after visitors.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
You know, considering
that natives like me are
looked down upon and
are kinda of lower class,
I'm really lucky to work for
Sir Zhed here in the mansion.

Excuse me, but do you
know a man named Phobe?
He's gone missing, so I've
been hired to look for him.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
Ah, so you're the one
that Vincent hired, huh?
That's good, that's good.
I'm pretty sure Phobe is
hiding somewhere and
just goofing around.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
I'm sure he can take care
of himself, so we won't have
to worry too much. Let's see,
he asked me if I had any
errands to for him to do,
so I sent him to the market.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
That's the last time I saw
him. I guess he's using the
money I gave him to feed himself
while he's run away. He's young,
so I can't really blame him.
We've all done crazy things~

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
Ah, our gardener Jenny
was the one that introduced
me to him. She's worked for
Sir Zhed for a long time, and
she loves kids. I guess she's
got a soft spot for Phobe.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
No one knows who his
parents are, so I guess
he's an orphan. That's
probably why she has him.
working with us in the mansion.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
Jenny has done a lot for
that boy. We skipped our
usual employment process
just for her, you know? And
now Jenny and even Vincent
are worried about him missing.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
You know, if you want to
know more about that kid,
you should talk to Jenny.
She's working in the garden
now, and she'd appreciate
your help in finding Phobe.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
You know, if you want to
know more about that kid,
you should talk to Jenny.
She's working in the garden
now, and she'd appreciate
your help in finding Phobe.

scripts.speaker: Manson
scripts.text:
Nuts, there's so much
work to do! I never seem
to get it all done until
the very end of the day.
Ah well, it's a living.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
These grounds are owned by
Sir Zhed and are considered
private property. Please
leave immediately if you
haven't been invited!

Excuse me, but are
you Jenny? I've been
told by Manson to speak
to you if I wanted to learn
more about Phobe. You see,
Vincent hired me to find him.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Oh! That's wonderful
news! Y-yes, I'm Jenny.
What did you need to know?

Er, anything you could
tell me would be fine.
Things like his favorite
hangouts might also be
helpful for me to investigate.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Phobe is such a good
boy. I don't know what
kind of trouble he's gotten
into this time, but he's
really a great kid if you
just give him a chance.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Oh... Vincent must
also be--I'm-I'm very
glad that he's hired
you. But as for places
he might be found, I'm
not sure if I know.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Have you tried the
market? That's where
he was last seen, wasn't it?
Maybe they have some idea
of where he was going?

Oh... That's a good idea.
Alright, I guess I can go
to the market and ask around.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Please find Phobe,
and bring him back
safely as soon as you

First, I guess I should ask

The jewel's been returned,

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Oh! Oh, I see. He told
you our secret? Well,
I guess we can trust you.
Mostly, I'm just relieved
that my son is alright, and
that he won't get in trouble.

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:
Anyway, even though Phobe
is being pretty stubborn,
I'm sure he'll come back
soon. As he grows up, I think

position a little bit better.

scripts.speaker: Jenny

it's been very hard for
all three of us to live
this way, I couldn't be
happier. Thank you for
all of your help, adventurer~

scripts.speaker: Jenny
scripts.text:

finding my son. If there's
anything I can ever do for
you, please let me know.
You don't know how grateful
I am to you as a mother...

age around here in the past

scripts.speaker: Phobe

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:
If I had only turned
myself in... Maybe if I had
made an effort to pay for
my crime, me and Bruspetti
could have had a chance...

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:
Please... Please just
leave me alone. I've lost
the woman I love because
of something stupid I did

turn me in, go ahead...

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:

fate to bear this guilt.

best chance of ever being
truly happy. Bruspetti...

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:

no reason to hide

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:
I used to work as one
of the security guards in
Lighthalzen. We basically
watched the border between
the rich area and the slums.

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:

to kill someone that was
repeatedly moving between
the slums and the rich area.
He was a wealthy kid...
Didn't really deserve it.

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:
I was paid a lot of money
to do it. At first, I thought
I was just doing my job. You
know, I mean, the law was on
my side. But the boy's blood
wouldn't wash off my hands...

scripts.speaker: Katinshuell
scripts.text:
I was scared to kill him,
but once I did it, the guilt
and the torment has been
unbearable! I haven't been

may I help you, my friend?
Mysterious Building in the Volcano

Actually, I was wondering
if you knew of anything about
this facility inside Thor
Volcano near Veins. There
might be something big
going on over there.

^3131FFYou told High Priest
Zhed about the shackled

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I see. I have my suspicions
about what is happening. Now,
you're aware that Arunafeltz
is governed by our church,
and that our entire nation
worships the goddess Freya.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
The priests that lead this
nation are split into two main
factions: I am considered part
of the moderate faction, which
usually butts heads with the
jingoistic hard-liner faction.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
These hard-liner priests
are more than willing to use
violent methods if they believe
it to be the will of Freya, and
are the ones that established
the military camp  at Thor Volcano.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Of course, it's also
considered a geology camp
since they're always monitoring
that place for volcanic activity,
but for all intents and purposes,
they are training men to fight.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
It scares me to think
about it, but I'm sure that
they have many military supplies
and machines of mass destruction
hidden over there in the camp.

Wait, what exactly do
they hope to accomplish
by fighting? How do they
intend to help the goddess
Freya by using violence?

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
All the priests agree that
reassembling Ymir's Heart will
revive Freya. As you know, the
pieces are scattered all over
the world. Some are possessed
by the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
In the interest of avoiding
conflict, the moderate faction
of priests decided to hire
scientists to reproduce Ymir's
Heart, resulting in an
imitation of that artifact.

An imitation of Ymir's
Heart? I think I know of
a famous scientist from the
Schwarzwald Republic that

see, his name was...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Oh, you've heard of him?

destroyed the Imitation of
Ymir's Heart into pieces,
and then disappeared.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
{0}?
No, that wasn't him.
The man that created the

He was truly a genius.

scripts.text:
I'm not sure what happened

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

Although the working

scripts.text:
Since our moderate faction,

unstable Ymir Heart imitations,

gained more respectability than
us in the eyes of the people.

scripts.text:
Despite our advanced weaponry
and armor, I'm afraid that our
country of Arunafeltz is not as
civilized and peaceful as I'd
like it to be, and the hard-liners
control our government now.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Although the hard-liners
allowed us to continue
our research in faithfully
reproducing Ymir's Heart,
they've been developing their
military might unopposed.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
So basically, the moderates

Heart at research centers
in the Holy Ground and the
Schwarzwald Republic.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
The hard-liners are

This doesn't look good.
I mean, if they're gearing
up to take the Ymir Heart
Pieces by force, it'll be war
against the Schwalzvalt Republic
and the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom!

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Seeing as I'm part of the

there may still be hope yet...

We priests of the moderate

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
The hard-liners actually
opposed our efforts, but

use imitation Ymir Hearts for
military purposes.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
The Ymir Heart reproduction

the best minds in the world,
and some scientists have even
resorted to using forbidden
methods. It's a shame, really.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Varmunt actually succeeded
in recreating Ymir's Heart,
but then he destroyed it and
he disappeared. He did it to
prevent war, but we could
really use his help now.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
The hard-liners are especially
fanatical in their devotion to
Freya, and will use any means
to further what they interpret
as her will. They're willing to
go to war for their beliefs.

Welcome, adventurer.
I'm glad to see that you're

expert assistance.

After all, I no longer have

Don't lose heart,

I... I believe in you!

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

scripts.text:
As you well know, the
highest authority in
Arunafeltz is our Pope,
the reincarnation of
our goddess Freya.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:

young and innocent, and she
doesn't yet have the experience

corruption among the priests.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
In these desperate times,
we will need someone to

leadership to the people
of Arunafeltz before all
is lost to war and violence.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I know it may not be

must do something

Y-you're not thinking
of overthrowing the
pope are you? I-isn't
that a bit extreme?

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
What? No, no!
Don't jump to conclusions
like that! Don't misunderstand
me: I'm loyal to our pope.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I actually want to work
very closely with the pope,
in essense, rule together with
her by combining my experience
and her wisdom. It's ambitious,
but what else can I do?

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
You remember how you
stopped the hard-liner
priests from carrying out
their plans for war in the
Thor Volcano camp? That will
only stop them temporarily.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
They'll eventually prepare
to act out in violence again.
We need a permanent solution
to ensure that this sort of
thing doesn't happen again.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
We need to convince the
pope to finally act, and
give my policy of peace
her full support. Will
you help me to do this?

Well... Asking for the

solution I've been able to

in Arunafeltz?

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

Well, I don't know.
It's a good idea, but
I fear that it will only
be effective in the short

try what I've proposed first?

Hmm, now how can
we convince the pope to
support us? Even as Freya's

a young girl. She probably
knows nothing of politics.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

It'd probably be best to

happening. The full truth.
In my heart, I know that

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

She might not be too

totally shock her.

Truth
Lies

Although I'm worried about

our message, I should have
faith. I should have faith.

scripts.text:
I suppose that you may
have a point. It might not
be a good idea to totally
expose her to the ugly
truth. I'll try to be as
honest as I can...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

Well, there's no time
to waste. The two of us may
not be enough to convince
the pope to act for peace.
I already have someone in
mind that might help us.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

My old friend, High Priest
Niren. I'm not sure if she'll
help me after all that's
happened between us. She

hurt to try! Besides,

Maybe she'll understand
the way you see things

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed

You're right, of course.
I'm just grasping at straws
here, but she and I both used

possible. I don't know why
she joined the hard-liners...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
{0}...
Would you please talk to

right away, though...

If you think that you
have a chance of convincing
her, then feel free and offer

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
There's actually
a good chance that
she is away somewhere
on business. She is highly
loved by the people, you know.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Please speak to Niren,

Hmm... This explains why
she and some other high
priests started being absent
from their offices. Many of
them were invited over to
the Schwarzwald Republic...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Regardless, I know for
a fact that war is never
a solution. It only brings
death and destruction.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Give me a moment.
I'm going to write
a letter that I want
you to give to Niren.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Please bring this letter
to Niren. I hope what
I have to say will help
her understand how I feel
about these plans for war.

^3355FFYou received a letter for

Please deliver my

I really appreciate
you helping me on this.

Great news! Niren just

give her any help that she

High Priest Niren managed

followers that were near the

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I hope we can get the pope
to understand the situation
of our nation. I only...

Alright, I'm ready.
Let's receive an
audience with the
pope, shall we?

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I'm a little nervous

I believe that Niren

you speak to her before
coming back to me?

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I'm glad that everything

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Yes, without our support,
Schwarzwald won't have
any excuse to continue
their dangerous research
for a little while, at least.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Thor Volcano Camp
should close down soon,
now that we no longer
have any use for it.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I also underestimated our
pope. She is more dignified,
willed that I believed.
I owe her my apologies.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
We won't give up on
reviving our goddess Freya,
but we will retrieve Ymir's
Heart through diplomacy
rather than violence.
It won't be easy...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
You've been instrumental
in returning peace here in
Arunafeltz. I've even been
reinstated, and will be very
busy from now on, working
closely with the pope...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I know that the life of
adventuring beckons you.
I know she'd like to see
you before you leave, but
she's sleeping deeply after
that exhausting speech...

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
On behalf of our pope
and all the citizens of
Arunafeltz, I'd like to
thank you for your heroism.
Your place in Valhalla is
already assured, I'm sure.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
May Freya bless you
on all your journeys,
my good friend.

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
Ugh...!
I've got such
a horrible headache!

scripts.speaker: High Priest Zhed
scripts.text:
I should rest for now.
Please travel in safety.

Nemma and I are descended
from a family of great alchemists.
They went on a long, religious
pilgrimage and ended up here.
They are the ones that built
this temple and security system.

scripts.speaker: Priestess Panno
scripts.text:
In a sense, this temple
is the tomb of our ancestors,
who left Rune-Midgarts and
built this city of Rachel about
a thousand years ago.

scripts.speaker: Priestess Panno
scripts.text:

Alchemists left Rune-Midgarts
and settled here, converting
the desert into green fields.
This temple was supposed
be a shelter from intruders.

scripts.speaker: Priestess Panno
scripts.text:

temple security system to
require a special permit in
order to access the temple
But the invaders never came,
and we didn't need the permits.

scripts.speaker: Priestess Panno
scripts.text:

security system was left on
the gate, just in case. Now,
I've heard that the security
